Some criteria specify output form rather than exact facts; judge does not see original conversation. Rubric passing does not independently verify factual correctness.

timing_definitions.generation_warm: Synchronized condition execution including relay operations/text-note generation and final decoding; excludes retrieval/index, source tokenization/scheduling, and shared independent-document prefill.
timing_definitions.guard: Wall clock includes setup/control overhead; resource statistics sampled every five seconds.
timing_definitions.judge: Synchronized prompt prefill and greedy grading decode; excludes prompt formatting/tokenization, parsing, fsync, and model loading. Separate from answer generation.
timing_definitions.shared_cold_ingest: Built once per question and reused across latent conditions; summed once per original question, not cold cost per arm.
timing_definitions.tokens: Output IDs exclude EOS; bridge recomputation separate from query-prefill. Judge tokens separate from candidate host/internal text.
